name: Grimo ☆ Love ~Houkago no Witch~
original_name: グリモ☆ラヴ ～放課後のウィッチ～
source:
Yuuma had his future all planned out: he would join the literature club, fall in love with his senpai, and become a best-selling light novel writer. However, it all came apart when his homeroom teacher informed him that the literature club had been disbanded many years ago. He couldn’t find another club where he would be able to write novels, so he ended up finding a nice place in the library to focus on his writing. Then, he was forcefully recruited to the student council as the secretary, mainly to take care of the mounds of paperwork which had piled up.

After some incident, he ended up as a member of the second literature club, which was actually the occult club and the Grimoire ended up in his hands. According to club leader Yuzuna, if one makes a contract with the book, then they will become popular with the opposite sex. She was really eager to try it, and he became her test subject. However, it actually possessed magic which made others sexually excited, causing all types of ecchi events to occur around him!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
裕真早已规划好未来：加入文学部，爱上学姐，成为畅销轻小说作家。然而，班主任告诉他文学部多年前就解散了，一切计划因此破灭。他找不到其他能写小说的社团，只好在图书馆找了个安静位置专心写作。之后，他被强行招入学生会担任秘书，主要负责处理堆积如山的文书。

某起事件后，他成了第二文学部的成员；这个社团其实是灵异研究部，而他手中还落入了一本魔导书。社团部长柚奈说，只要与这本书签订契约，就能受到异性欢迎。她迫不及待地想尝试，于是让裕真当实验对象。然而，这本书真正拥有的是让他人产生性兴奋的魔法，结果各种色情事件在他身边接连发生！
